description: ☰ → Terminal: a full-window view over the chat, as the Kubernetes view is, of tabs of Multiplex terminals, each run on a host by its host process (wire's terminal op) and drawn here. It can move out to a window of its own (Multiplex's look) and back.

parts.name: bar
parts.shows: The view's top bar: "Terminal" (heading), the shown terminal's host by name (dim), then flat buttons New tab and Move to Its Own Window, and a round Close (×).

actions.does: A new terminal on the host picked in the window's host dropdown, in a new tab

actions.by: click Move to Its Own Window
actions.does: The tabs move to a window titled Multiplex (its frame, a New tab button in its header); the view closes. Closing that window puts them back here, shown.
Closes the view; its terminals keep running and are there when it opens again

parts.name: tabs
parts.shows: A tab per terminal, titled by its program (else its host); the strip only with more than one tab, as Emission's and Multiplex's. A tab whose program ended while a Bot was at it says (ended) and stays till closed; any other closes as its program ends.

parts.name: terminal

decisions.said: Terminal keys as iTerm2 and Terminal.app have them: Cmd+T, Cmd+W, Cmd+C, Cmd+V on a Mac; Ctrl+Shift on Linux
decisions.rule: Every desktop app's terminal takes Cmd+T/W/C/V on macOS and Ctrl+Shift+T/W/C/V on Linux for new tab, close tab, copy and paste

decisions.said: Without VTE on macOS the error isn't clear; give proper guidance
decisions.rule: Every app without a terminal library says what to install, the command for its platform, and to restart

decisions.said: In Multiplex, Ctrl+L to clear the window adds to the scrollback: it seems to insert a lot of empty lines, which it shouldn't do at all
decisions.rule: Every terminal (Multiplex's tabs, the Terminal view, a Kubernetes pod's shell, on any app) clears its screen (Ctrl+L, clear) as iTerm2 does: the rows down to the cursor's go into the scrollback, no blank screen of rows after them, so clearing again and again adds only the prompt's row each time

parts.shows: The terminal (VTE), its edges glowing in the accent while a Bot is at its terminal tools there. What's typed goes to the program on its host. A host that can't be reached says why in it. Cmd+C and Cmd+V copy and paste, Cmd+T and Cmd+W open and close a tab (Ctrl+Shift with the same letters on Linux). Ctrl+L (or clear) clears the screen, keeping the rows down to the cursor's in the scrollback and no blank rows after them. Without VTE, ☰ → Terminal opens nothing and a toast says what to install for the platform and to restart.
